hooks.name: reinvent-compass-pre-write-guardrail
hooks.description: Checks a Compass booking before it runs. Kiro sends every Power tool call as kiro_powers, and the hook picks out the Compass ones. The Compass server checks every booking again.

hooks.name: reinvent-compass-block-awsevents-writes
hooks.description: Blocks the write tools of the official awsevents server, so every booking goes through Compass. The matcher is lower case because Kiro matches regular expressions against the lower-cased tool id.
